method: Built-in imagegen; full-body frame-by-frame sprite prototypes; not runtime assets

generations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Input image is a character IDENTITY AND PAINTING STYLE REFERENCE, not a pose to copy. Create a NEW finished sprite animation sheet, exactly EIGHT individually drawn full-body frames of this same friendly fantasy skeleton soldier WALKING TOWARD THE RIGHT in side view. This is true frame-by-frame whole-character animation: redraw the silhouette, body weight shift, ankle and knee articulation and foot roll in every pose; NOT separated puppet parts, NOT eight near-identical standing characters. Preserve rusty helmet, ivory skull and bones, olive rag tunic, brown belt and boots, spear in the same hand. Consistent face, equipment, proportions and painterly game style; no gore or horror.
Layout: landscape sheet, exactly4 equal columns by2 equal rows, read left to right top row frames1-4 then bottom row5-8. Wide empty gutters, complete spear/helmet/boots in every cell, identical camera/scale, body root centered per cell, a common invisible floor within each row. No labels, numbers, border, ground shadow or ground line. True transparent alpha background, otherwise pure white.
Animation: one complete balanced biped WALK cycle sampled at8 consecutive phases. The near leg is brighter, the far leg slightly shaded and behind. They must visibly exchange front/back order. The support knee is nearly extended; only load absorption and swinging leg bend. No continuous squat, no backward knees.
FRAME1 near heel reaches FORWARD to the right, far foot trails LEFT behind on its toe; widest split/contact.
FRAME2 near foot accepts weight, pelvis drops slightly, far heel lifts behind with knee flexing.
FRAME3 near leg supports nearly STRAIGHT under the hip, pelvis high, far leg bends and passes forward beside the supporting knee; narrow passing silhouette.
FRAME4 near foot is now BEHIND pushing off its toe, far shin reaches FORWARD preparing heel contact.
FRAME5 OPPOSITE contact: far heel fully FORWARD to the right, near foot trails LEFT behind on toe; widest split, opposite foot identity to frame1.
FRAME6 far foot accepts weight, near heel lifts behind, slight pelvis drop.
FRAME7 far support leg nearly STRAIGHT under hip; near knee flexed and passing FORWARD, pelvis high.
FRAME8 far foot behind pushing off toe; near shin swings forward ready to return seamlessly to frame1.
Small coordinated shoulder counter-rotation, natural arm/spear follow-through and tunic movement. Keep head recognizably stable without stretching body parts. Precisely8 complete distinct walking drawings, not disconnected limbs or a rig.
generations.review: Rejected as complete walk: second half repeats same support leg.

generations.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Input image is the complete assembled boar character IDENTITY, ANATOMY AND STYLE reference. Create a NEW finished sprite animation sheet of this exact stocky fantasy boar WALKING TOWARD THE RIGHT, strict consistent side view, using EIGHT individually drawn whole-character poses across ONE full natural quadruped walking cycle. Redraw complete continuous anatomy per frame, no detached puppet parts or pasted round thigh patches.
Preserve long horizontal barrel ribcage, full hind rump, large shoulder, short stout legs, real front elbows and rear stifle/hock bends, orange eye, mane, short ivory tusks, healthy brown fur and leather harness. Friendly determined painted game character, no gore, rot or realistic horror. Consistent shape/scale/markings/equipment through all8.
Layout exactly4 equal columns ×2 equal rows on a landscape sheet. Frames1-4 top,5-8 bottom;8full animals only. Identical camera/root center, stable size and invisible floor at same relative height per row; generous empty gutters; all tail/hooves/nose in cell. True transparent alpha background, otherwise pure white. NO text, numbers, borders, floor or shadows.
Motion is a deliberate FOUR-BEAT WALK, not trot, hop or shuffle. Four different anatomically attached limbs, near legs brighter and far legs darker. Near/far FRONT feet exchange anterior/posterior order during the cycle, and near/far HIND feet also exchange order; front shoulders stay front and rear hips stay rear. Clear leg swing under the belly, real lifted hooves, stance feet moving backward relative to body, heel/hoof lift at toe-off. Shoulder/scapula slides beneath the fur, weight shifts subtly, back/mane/tail have small coordinated motion. Keep contact legs bearing weight.
Eight consecutive phases, with an individual foot landing every two frames:
1 near HIND hoof reaches forward and contacts, near FRONT leg beginning to swing forward; far hind supports.
2 near FRONT foreleg swings visibly forward with bent elbow and raised hoof; other legs support.
3 near FRONT hoof now lands ahead of shoulder; far HIND leg begins its forward swing with bent stifle/hock.
4 far HIND hoof travels forward beneath rump; near fore bears weight and rear near leg pushes backward.
5 far HIND hoof lands forward; far FRONT begins swinging forward. Near/far hind order is reversed from1.
6 far FRONT hoof swings forward; near front foot trails backward pushing off.
7 far FRONT hoof lands ahead of shoulder; near HIND starts forward swing with hock folded. Near/far front order is reversed from3.
8 near HIND hoof swings forward to return to frame1; other feet support.
Use substantial readable alternating strides, clear changing silhouettes, not eight copies of the reference stance. Hooves must not all remain in their original forward/back positions. Finished integrated full-character animation drawings, no rig seams, no whole-body translation pretending to walk.
generations.review: Unified full-body art improved; foreleg alternating swing ambiguous.
